_note: Curated starter templates. The factory clones one as the base (marmelab's 'don't reinvent the wheel'), then stamps the harness on top. SUPPLY CHAIN: refs below point at moving branches for convenience — pin 'ref' to a tag or commit SHA before relying on a starter in production (fetch_starter.py --ref accepts any ref). Cloning is safe, but the FIRST `npm install`/`pip install` you run on a starter executes upstream postinstall code on your machine — review it. Add your own entries freely.
